title: Spider
tagline: One suit. Eight kings to ace. Optional undo.
blurb: 104 cards, all one suit. Ten columns. Build down in rank. A complete K–A run peels off. Deal a row only when no column is empty. Pre-deal undo option. Complete K–A runs auto-clear.

copy.playing: Tap a descending run, then a column. Stock deals a row.
copy.options: Undo on or off, then DEAL.
